newsitem.title: USA: ITT Industries picked to supply sensors.
newsitem.headline: ITT Industries picked to supply sensors.

text.p: ITT Industries Inc's ITT Defense and Electronics unit said Tuesday the National Aeronautics and Space Administration selected it as sole supplier of meterological instruments for the newest Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite constellation.
In September, ITT will begin production on $177 million worth of sensors that wil provide updated 24-hour-a-day coverage of atmospheric conditions of the Earth's western hemisphere.
